page.layout: One printed page: title block at top centre (title in large spaced capitals with two lines of italic imprint below), then a woodcut device with motto in an oval frame, then "ANNO" and the date line below the device. A library stamp at lower left is not transcribed.
page.notes: The woodcut device shows two hands clasping above a cornucopia-like vessel with fruit, rays above, inside an oval band reading "SERVATA FIDES" and "MATHES HARNISCH" with "DITAT" below; the device is not transcribed as text beyond the band words. The first title line reads "NEOSTADII IN PA-" with the hyphen at the line end, continuing "LATINATU"; the initial N is a decorated capital. The date line is printed as "clɔ. lɔ. lxxxv." in the old reversed-C form, which would read MDLXXXV; the final v appears to be a V. Several letters in the date line are uncertain and the imprint line reads "latinatu, excudebat Matthæus Harnisch." in italic type.
